title: The anti-rug restart-resume tests mock the resume SQL, give every chain a single dex per pool type and never assert which dex a position is re-registered with, so the registered S1 (positions re-registered on the first dex of their type, not the dex bought on) passes green; five of the ten cases are source-text greps

evidence.note: getResumeAntiRugTrades / getResumeExitMonitorTrades are mocks whose rows the test injects
buildChainCtx gives each chain one V2 and one V3 dex
Test 27 rows have no dex_name and the assertion reads only the trade id argument (:464)
resume picks ctx.chain.dexes.find(d => d.dexType === trade.pool_type), the first dex of that type (AUD-ANTIRUG-011)
Test 28 comment: "the ordering invariant is enforced by implementation — we test it via Test 27"; Test 27 asserts no order
Test 31 "excluded by INNER JOIN" regex-matches the SQL text in db.ts (:551-558) instead of running it
Tests 22-26 assert substrings and index order in src/bot.ts source text

sibling_sites_checked: Resume paths in the TESTI slice: botWiring (anti-rug resume), preflightInvocation / midRunWalletCheck / pauseFlow (resume statements mocked to return []), test/fork/exitStatePersistence.fork.test.ts (exit-monitor resume on a fork, Task 2). The unit sibling for the exit-monitor resume is AUD-TESTU-005.
severity_rationale: S2: mocked SQL plus a single-dex fixture on the restart-resume path hide the registered S1s AUD-ANTIRUG-011 and AUD-EXIT-013 (wrong dex after restart).
recommendation: Phase 28: seed a temp DB (from the real migration, see AUD-TESTI-001) with a buy on the second V2 dex of a chain, run resumeAntiRugMonitoring and resumeMultiChainMonitoring against it, and assert the dex passed to registerAntiRugPosition / resumeExitMonitor is the stored dex_name (RED today). Replace the source-text greps with behavioural assertions.
affected_cases: Test 27: queries trades JOIN lp_baseline and re-registers each row via registerAntiRugPosition
Test 28: calls verifyAllowlistAtStartup once per chain BEFORE the re-register loop
Test 31: pre-Phase-19 trades (no lp_baseline) are excluded by INNER JOIN
escaped_regression: Today: after a restart a position bought on sushiswap-v2 (ETH) or biswap-v2 (BSC) is re-registered for anti-rug with the first V2 dex of the chain (AUD-ANTIRUG-011) and Test 27 stays green because the fixture has one V2 dex and the dex argument is not asserted.
